Title: Migrate from Bing Speech to Speech Services and the Speech SDK by January 14, 2020

Body.Content:
We’re extending the Bing Speech retirement date to January 14, 2020. Bing Speech API will continue supporting your applications until January 14, 2020. However, we encourage you to migrate to Speech Services and the Speech SDK as soon as possible to enjoy their rich benefits including:

  • Speech-to-text (speech recognition), intent, translation, and text-to-speech capabilities.
  • Batch transcription capability through a dedicated REST API.
  • A larger set of adaptable locales, new and more accurate models, and improved modes of interaction.

Contact us

Learn more about migrating your Bing Speech application to Speech.
